summary:
The change removes HTML escaping from `Comment` and passes the raw `body` prop directly into `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`. This turns an otherwise safe comment renderer into an XSS vector: any untrusted or user-supplied content (or even a compromised upstream source) can now inject arbitrary markup, event handlers, or scripts. The stated goal of supporting bold/links is not implemented; the diff simply trusts the input. No sanitization, markdown parser, or allow-list is present. This is a critical correctness and security regression on the only changed file.
